scope: Offline experiment only; no app, serving, source roster, user history or event DB writes.
arms: Current production DB/date window: report availability and chronological ordering, no invented production score.
Existing NYC Parks source with visit-day override; same eligibility filters and experimental score.
Fixed public-web discovery pass with the same visit-day eligibility and experimental score.
retrieval_limit: First five distinct URLs returned per query, max 30 pooled URLs. Preserve order/dedupe by URL. No further search queries. Read at most 12 matching event/venue pages, following one official event link and one venue/about page if needed. Do not search event names or target a known venue.
eligibility: Evidence of event occurrence overlapping September 20, 2026 in NYC local time.
Public listing with an identifiable NYC venue. Exclude explicit cancellation/private-only/access-incompatible events. Record fees, RSVP or uncertain access without inventing availability.
Search snippet without supporting publisher/organizer page goes to unverified leads, not confirmed ranking.
A listing of continuous daily opening hours is not an event.

label_rules.coffee_centered_activity: Explicit coffee/espresso/tea/matcha tasting, brewing, cafe-drink popup or coffee social as an advertised event activity; incidental menu drinks or a business name are insufficient.
label_rules.verified_coffee_serving_cafe_setting: Publisher/venue evidence that the event setting is a coffee-serving cafe or temporary cafe. A nightclub named Cafe is insufficient.
label_rules.explicit_social_or_participatory_activit: Explicit meetup, workshop, art/vendor fair, shared game, run club, dance party or other participant interaction; passive music alone is insufficient.

score_limits: Uncalibrated, hand-specified cafe relevance points; not liking probability, authenticity, quality or safety. Unknown evidence earns zero with an uncertainty note. Date/city/access are gates, not bonus points. No proximity score without a neighborhood.
ties: Score descending, then local start time ascending, then title alphabetically.
prior_exposure: Sequoia Cafe events calendar including Storytelling Art Fair and Final Shop Day
Jazz in NYC cafe jam listing
bias_control: Friend event identity remains unknown. Mark resurfaced previously seen leads. This is not an entirely unseen discovery benchmark; no changes to queries/weights/labels after results or owner feedback. Missing sources are misses, never fabricated zero-fit rankings.
